title: Italian Shrimp Tarte Tatin
description: A unique Italian twist on the classic French dessert, featuring succulent shrimp and a silky caramel sauce.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shrimp and cook, flipping halfway, until pink and cooked through.
Transfer the shrimp to a plate and set aside.
Roll out the pre-made tarte tatin dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the dough into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the cooked shrimp on the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the honey and lemon juice over the shrimp.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the shrimp, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
